source_text: 我去过许多废土上的地方。我们去过的最近的地方是沙荫镇和迦克镇。他们因为我们去他们的地方感到非常高兴。

text: You visit Shady Sands?

text: Where's Junktown?

text: 迦克镇在哪？

text: You are starting to become annoying now. I think I will end that slight problem.

text: We are the Khan, and our leader is Garl. We are the most feared group in the wasteland, and with good reason. We take what we want, and those who get in our way pay the price.
source_text: We are the Khan, and our leader is Garl. We are the most feared group in the wasteland, and with good reason. We take what we want, and those who get in our way pay the price.

text: Yes, we go to Shady Sands from time to time. It adds a little excitement to the lives of everyone concerned.

text: Why, Junktown is just a little bit to the south of here. Go a few miles, turn right at the dying cactus. You can't miss it!
